reference: Michael hitting Meredith with his car came first: 'Fun Run' (S4E1, season 4 premiere). Dwight's fire drill (the staged fire 'simulation') is in 'Stress Relief' (S5E13 here; S5E14-15 in split numbering).

evidence.line: Michael: Well, I ran down Meredith in my car.
Michael: Ladies and Gentlemen. I have some bad news. Meredith was hit by a car.
Dwight: Last week I gave a fire safety talk. And nobody paid any attention. ... experience is the best teacher. [lights a cigarette]
Dwight: Attention everyone! ... This has been a test of our emergency preparedness. There is no fire. It was only a simulation.

caveats: The words 'fire drill' never appear in the transcripts; Dwight calls it a 'simulation' / 'test of our emergency preparedness'. Stress Relief is a combined two-part episode (S5E13 here, S5E14-15 split).
question: Which came first: Michael hitting Meredith with his car, or Dwight's fire drill?
